Trigger / Rule: The folder tree IS the orchestration / never build an orchestrator
Fires when: Always — governs every design decision and every session
What happens — side effects & details: No script or framework ever drives a pipeline. A workspace = stage contracts + human gates; stages run when Jamie enters them; nothing advances work across a gate; no outbound action leaves a session. D11 narrows: a project repo`s own deterministic one-job scripts, and CI acting only after a human-authorised merge, are factory, not orchestrator. icm-board itself drives nothing — it describes, checks, seeds.
Assessment: Good — the founding rule; survived the return of the business processes intact and D11`s narrowing is precise. It is the reason a resolver (read-only) is legal but a scheduler is not.

Defined in: `AGENTS.md`; `PIPELINE.md` § Gates; pipeline SKILL step 5; global icm-session-start hook (injects the line every ICM session)

Assessment: Good — crisp, universally stated, and mechanically supported (anchors). One of the few rules injected programmatically every session.
